# VCA Animal Hospitals

> VCA Animal Hospitals is a North American network providing world-class veterinary care across primary, specialty, emergency, and urgent care facilities with integrated wellness programs and pet health resources.

VCA Animal Hospitals operates one of the largest veterinary hospital networks in North America, offering comprehensive pet care services from routine wellness to emergency medicine. The organization emphasizes preventive care through its CareClub membership program and provides extensive educational resources for pet owners.

## Get Started & Find Care

- [Find A VCA Animal Hospital Near You](https://vcahospitals.com/find-a-hospital): Hospital locator to find VCA primary, specialty, emergency, and urgent care
- [Location Directory | VCA Animal Hospitals](https://vcahospitals.com/find-a-hospital/location-directory): VCA hospital directory searchable by state with all location listings
- [Book A Vet Appointment With VCA Animal Hospitals](https://vcahospitals.com/book-an-appointment): Online appointment booking for wellness and sick visits at VCA hospitals
- [Free First Pet Exam | VCA Animal Hospitals](https://vcahospitals.com/free-first-exam): Free first exam promotional offer for new VCA Animal Hospitals clients

## Pet Wellness & Financial Options

- [VCA CareClub® Pet Wellness Plans | VCA Animal Hospitals](https://vcahospitals.com/careclub): VCA CareClub pet wellness membership plans with preventive care savings
- [Shop myVCA: Veterinarian Approved Pet Products](https://vcahospitals.com/shop): myVCA online pharmacy and pet products shop with prescriptions and autoship
- [Financial Resources for Veterinary Care Costs](https://vcahospitals.com/veterinary-financial-resources): Financing options including CareClub, CareCredit, and pet insurance alternatives

## Pet Health & Care Resources

- [World-Class Pet Care Resources | VCA Animal Hospitals](https://vcahospitals.com/resources): Pet care guides, health tips, and wellness resources from VCA veterinarians
- [How to Care for Your Puppy & Kitten | Pediatric Resources](https://vcahospitals.com/pediatric): Puppy and kitten care guides covering veterinary care and training tips
- [Know Your Pet | VCA Animal Hospitals](https://vcahospitals.com/know-your-pet): Pet health library with illness information and disease symptom guides
- [2025 Summer Hazards Playbook for Pet Owners - Inspiring Animal Stories | VCA Voice](https://vcahospitals.com/vca-voice/2025-summer-hazards-playbook-for-pet-owners): Summer pet safety guide with hazard prevention and emergency care tips
